evidence: Flat directory structure with max_directory_depth = 1 (all files at root level, no nested package folders)
Low average fan-out (1.5) indicating minimal inter-module dependencies
Main application logic centralized in main.py with many top-level functions (e.g., index, auth, new_chat, get_balance)
Supporting utilities (log_util.py, LRU_cache.py) are standalone modules without clear architectural boundaries
Flask routes are implemented as top-level functions without explicit layering (controllers mixed with business logic)
Frontend is static HTML/CSS/JS served directly with no clear separation into frontend architecture
No ports/adapters, no clear domain/core layer, no service layer or data access abstraction
risks: Lack of modularity leads to tight coupling and difficulty in testing
Monolithic flat structure hinders maintainability as codebase grows
Global functions in main.py increase cognitive load and risk of side effects
No separation of concerns between presentation, business logic, and data access
Limited scalability and testability without clear boundaries
